It will be provided in an Open format (the aim is a customizable OpenScad format), together with the appropriate documentation, production/installation/operation and DOFFING instructions. It is a volunteers project started in the FaceShields discussion groups during the great civic mobilization during the COVID19 pandemic and spinned off as an independent initiative at the request of medical professionals in the Timisoara, Romania, area.
